layers.text: Recolour only his skin: the face, ears, chest, belly, arms and hands become moss green, colour #5f7d3a with #3f5626 shadows: clearly green, a mid-tone, and the face stays clearly visible. Keep everything else exactly the same: the pot helmet, tusks, eyes, the brown leather straps and kilt, the plank shield with its iron rim, the cleaver, boots, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
